field.name: enable_multimodal
field.help: When enabled, users can upload images in the chat and the AI will analyse them using a Vision-Language Model (VLM).

field.name: multimodal_vlm_model
field.help: The VLM to use, e.g. 'Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct'. This model must already be deployed in GPUStack.

field.name: multimodal_vlm_endpoint
field.help: Override the inference endpoint. Leave blank to use the default GPUStack server.

ol.li: Deploy a VLM (e.g. Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct) in GPUStack.
Ensure the model name matches exactly what is entered above.
GPUStack will automatically handle the multimodal projector file.

field.name: enable_robotics
field.help: Enable the LangGraph supervisor to call ROS 2 actions and services. Requires an MCP-to-ROS bridge (e.g. RoboNeuron).

field.name: robotics_ros2_master_uri
field.help: The URI of the ROS 2 master node, e.g. http://robot-ip:11311.

field.name: robotics_vla_model
field.help: Vision-Language-Action model for robotic control, e.g. 'OpenVLA-7B'. Must be deployed in GPUStack/vLLM.

ol.li: Install the MCP-to-ROS bridge (RoboNeuron) on the robot controller.
Deploy a VLA model in GPUStack.
Verify network connectivity between the LangGraph container and the ROS 2 master.

field.name: enable_iot
field.help: Enable MQTT subscriber for sensor data streams.

field.name: iot_mqtt_broker
field.help: Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker (e.g. Eclipse Mosquitto).

ol.li: Deploy an MQTT broker (e.g. docker run -d --name mosquitto eclipse-mosquitto).
Ensure the broker is reachable from the LangGraph container.

field.name: enable_edge_deployment
field.help: Enable automatic deployment of quantized models on Jetson, Raspberry Pi, and Coral TPU devices.

field.name: edge_default_quantization
field.help: Choose the quantization level. 4-bit is recommended for most edge devices to save memory.

ol.li: Ensure the target edge device runs the NETTRADES GPU Agent.
The agent will automatically detect the device type (Jetson, Raspberry Pi, Coral) and report it to Odoo.
No additional configuration is needed on the edge device – the agent handles model deployment.
